title: 02 Onboarding
subtitle: First launch is Home: sign in to cloud.maude.sh once, and your first sentence becomes your first project — a local project and everything else one step aside
brief: nejaky onboarding ale ne tak slozity jako ted, vse smerujeme predevsim na to aby uzivatele pouzivali cloud.maude.sh vse ostatni je advanced ale rozkresli to a nebo chci jen vytvorit lokalni projekt · musime proste vychazet z predpokladu ze vsichni chteji jen to nejjednodussi reseni a to je nainstalovat desktop a zatim neco tvorit.

sections.title: Cloud first — a brand-new account
sections.subtitle: First launch is Home: sign in once in the browser, then your first sentence becomes your first cloud project — no wizard, no card, no tour

sections.title: Joining a team
sections.subtitle: Tereza's link, opened before Maude is installed — install, sign in, and you land on her comment, not on a menu

sections.title: “Just a local project”
sections.subtitle: No account: name it, make something, and move it to the cloud only when you want to share

sections.title: Advanced — one disclosure away, nothing removed
sections.subtitle: Self-hosted hub, a folder or GitHub project, AI connected up front, the maude command and plugin, Figma — and where every old door went

sections.title: When the first run isn't simple
sections.subtitle: Offline, a sign-in that never finished, a second Mac, a work invite in a personal app, no AI yet, after an update — words, not errors

artboards.label: 1 · First launch is Home
artboards.note: Home is the welcome: the question, the prompt, and one card — Sign in to cloud.maude.sh or Just a local project; Advanced options is a quiet link.

artboards.label: 2 · Sign in in the browser
artboards.note: cloud.maude.sh in the browser (Google or email; same buttons sign up); the app waits in words with Cancel; the browser asks once to open Maude.

artboards.label: 3 · Back on Home — signed in, nothing made yet
artboards.note: Proposed: the 14-day trial starts silently, no card, no waiting room; the chip says the sentence starts a new project.

artboards.label: 4 · First send — connect Claude, just in time
artboards.note: Proposed: AI is the person's own Claude account — one sheet at the first send, then the sentence runs; not an onboarding step.

artboards.label: 5 · AI draws the first canvas
artboards.note: The poster builds piece by piece; no tip card while AI works; the project is named from the sentence, Rename is the toast's one action.

artboards.label: 6 · How a first draft arrives
artboards.note: Signature moment: colour, picture, words, details — four frames on a time rail; one contextual hint at the first selection.

artboards.label: 7 · The invite, in the browser
artboards.note: Who invited you, to what, her comment, one download; Open in Maude if installed; view-only browser link kept.

artboards.label: 8 · Landed on her comment
artboards.note: Hero: the camera stops at Tereza's comment on the poster, reply field ready, her live cursor beside it. You land in Preview with Comment (you came to answer); esc is Edit.

artboards.label: 9 · Next time — Home shows the team's work
artboards.note: Home shows Alligators brand with 93 canvases, Tereza and Jonas; the prompt chip says the new canvas lands there.

artboards.label: 10 · Name it — that's all
artboards.note: One field; stored in your Maude folder on this Mac, said in words; the path appears only under Advanced.

artboards.label: 11 · The first local canvas
artboards.note: An empty canvas with the CONTRACT line; AI connects the same way at the first Ask AI; status says Local project.

artboards.label: 12 · Local — Share offers the cloud
artboards.note: Laptop on the tab and the Local project status word; pressing Share offers Move to cloud — never a nag elsewhere.

artboards.label: 13 · Moved — now Share invites
artboards.note: After the move canvases sync in the background; Share opens on Invite; invite by GitHub username waits under Advanced.

artboards.label: 14 · Advanced options, opened
artboards.note: A flyout beside the sign-in card lists hub, folder/GitHub, AI, maude command + plugin, Figma — one sheet each.

artboards.label: 15 · The Advanced sheets
artboards.note: Hub address + email/password, folder or GitHub project, Claude vs API key, CLI + plugin, Figma import (frames arrive as exact pictures; Make editable per artboard needs Figma Dev Mode), Share › Advanced GitHub invite.

artboards.label: 16 · Settings and where every old door went
artboards.note: General › Account opens cloud.maude.sh (people, billing, Macs, download, delete); Connections holds hub, AI, Figma, GitHub; the old-door map.

artboards.label: 17 · Offline at first launch
artboards.note: Local project becomes the main button; cloud sign-in rests and wakes up by itself; Ask AI stays enabled and says when AI is back (CONTRACT §7).

artboards.label: 18 · Sign-in never finished
artboards.note: Cancel (app or web page) or a 10-minute timeout brings the card back with one line: nothing changed.

artboards.label: 19 · Already signed in on another Mac
artboards.note: Cloud projects and recents arrive by themselves; a local project stays on the Mac that made it until Move to cloud.

artboards.label: 20 · A work invite in a personal app
artboards.note: The invite is for you@work-studio.cz; Open puts it in its own tab signed in as work; person circles vs project squares.

artboards.label: 21 · No AI connected yet — on a team project
artboards.note: Ask AI looks the same (CONTRACT §7); ⌘/ on Tereza's poster opens the one Connect sheet; each person brings their own Claude account.

artboards.label: 22 · After an update — findable, never in the way
artboards.note: Land where you left off (1.x too); Home shows one What's new line once; Menu › Help keeps the dot.
